edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties. Payment shall be made without deduction or setoff.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the matters described in the Recitals that accrued on or before execution of this Agreement. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, disclosures required by law or court order, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.

The record does not supply the dispute particulars or an appropriate governing law and forum, so those items remain bracketed for confirmation rather than being invented. Provide meaningful nonpayment remedies without double recovery. Obtain partner and client approval before sending.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Subject to client approval and agreement on the complete package, we propose a Settlement Amount of USD 32,000,000, payable within ten business days after execution. We have narrowed the recitals and release to the specifically identified dispute; please provide or confirm the bracketed dispute particulars. We have also added governing-law and exclusive-forum provisions for completion by agreement, together with notice, a short cure period, and remedies for nonpayment. The release remains effective only upon full payment. All proposals remain subject to execution of a mutually acceptable agreement.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve only the dispute concerning [identify the transaction or agreement, its date, the conduct at issue, and the subject matter of the asserted claims], as asserted in [identify applicable demand correspondence or action, including court and case number, if any] (the “Dispute”). The Dispute does not include unrelated transactions, conduct, or claims merely because they involve the same parties.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties. Payment shall be made without deduction or setoff. “Business day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a federal banking holiday in the United States.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant solely from claims arising out of the Dispute specifically identified in the Recitals that accrued on or before execution of this Agreement. No unrelated claim is released. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement, including accrued interest and enforcement costs, or claims to enforce it. No dismissal with prejudice of any pending action concerning the Dispute shall be required before receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds.

5. GOVERNING LAW; FORUM. This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or relating to it shall be governed by the laws of [agreed State], without regard to conflict-of-laws rules. Each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts located in [agreed County and State] and, where federal subject-matter jurisdiction exists, the United States District Court for [agreed District], for any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives objections to personal jurisdiction or venue in those courts.

6. NONPAYMENT. Any Settlement Amount not paid when due shall bear simple interest from its due date until payment at the lesser of nine percent per annum and the maximum lawful rate. If Defendant fails to pay when due, Plaintiff shall give written notice to Defendant at [designated notice email and address]. If the failure continues for five business days after receipt of that notice, Plaintiff may elect either to enforce this Agreement or, by further written notice, terminate the settlement and pursue the underlying claims concerning the Dispute. Termination shall extinguish the obligation to pay the Settlement Amount, without affecting Plaintiff's right to credit any partial payment against recovery on the underlying claims. Plaintiff shall not obtain double recovery. In an action to enforce Defendant's payment obligations under this Agreement, Plaintiff, if successful, shall be entitled to reasonable attorneys' fees and costs incurred in that enforcement.
